title: Ellsworth inner zone alert: saucer beams light at missile
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ellsworth inner zone alert: saucer beams light at missile, about 1960s at Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: call me back and said sir for lack of a better description of the Flying Saucer hovering over that missile and there's a beam of reddish light going down to
and as we turned left there sat this object on top of November 5 that was about 10 ft in the air directly on top of that blast door that was the size of a Walmart building
tellings.difference: Dates it to 1977 rather than the 1960s, names site November-5 and says the object was the size of a Walmart, with no reddish beam mentioned.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe a saucer hovering over a missile site at Ellsworth that the security team was sent to check. This telling gives Mario Woods' view of the object over November-5.

as_told.title: Mario Woods: Walmart-sized craft over November-5 and beings
as_told.place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota (site November-5)

tellings.quote: the case was he his partner and the truck had been transported roughly five miles to a reservoir near a little town
tellings.difference: Adds that the men and truck were moved about five miles to a reservoir near New Underwood, and dates it to the 1960s rather than 1977.
tellings.link_reason: Hastings sums up the same Mario Woods case at Ellsworth: after the encounter, Woods, his partner and the truck ended up five miles away at a reservoir.

as_told.title: Mario Woods and his truck moved five miles to a reservoir near New Underwood
as_told.place_text: Reservoir near New Underwood, South Dakota (Ellsworth AFB missile field)

tellings.quote: stepped out on the ground and sunk in wet mud so somehow the mud had been heated up right around the truck
tellings.difference: Adds that the mud around the truck was warm and wet on a subzero night.
tellings.link_reason: The heated mud around the truck belongs to the same reservoir scene as telling 6, in the same Woods encounter.

as_told.title: Mud heated around the truck on a subzero night
as_told.place_text: Reservoir near New Underwood, South Dakota

tellings.quote: to him. And I've also met Mario Woods who was stationed at, you know, South Dakota Ellsworth Air Force Base in 1978. He claimed to have boarded a craft and been abducted
tellings.difference: Dates it to 1978, where the story says the 1960s, and frames it as an abduction told to Michels in person.
tellings.link_reason: Same Mario Woods incident at Ellsworth, in which he was taken aboard a craft near a missile site.

tellings.quote: most credible cases for me is a guy named Mario Woods who was at Ellsworth Air Force Base in 1977 in South Dakota.
tellings.difference: Dates the incident to 1977, where the story has the 1960s, and describes the object as an orb.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the Mario Woods and Michael Johnson incident at Ellsworth AFB: a craft over a missile site followed by missing time.

as_told.title: Ellsworth Air Force Base orb and missing time
as_told.place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: book there's a you know a friend of mine at Ellsworth Air Force Base 1977. He woke up 9 miles away.
tellings.difference: Gives the year as 1977 and the distance as 9 miles, where Hastings's telling says about five miles; the teller calls the witness a friend and does not name him.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell the 1977 Ellsworth AFB experience of Mario Woods, who woke up miles away from where he had been. The Ellsworth story's tellings credit Woods and describe his truck being moved to a reservoir.
